svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A short rectangular tube that shades the sensor window without

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cutting into its 55 x 35 degree view.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a cross-shaped blank: a 30 x 20 mm centre opening edged by four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 19 mm sides (two 30 mm wide, two 20 mm wide), plus a 11 mm flange

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the outer end of the top and bottom sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the four sides 90 degrees to make a tube 28 mm wide and 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tall inside, 20 mm deep; fold the two flanges 90 degrees outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 3.4 mm hole in the middle of each flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flanges lie flat on the west wall of the pod, the opening

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred on the window, wide side horizontal; two M3 stainless

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: from the window, the inside edges are at least 31 degrees off

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the axis sideways and 19 degrees up and down.
